d:
Mr Bean Animated opens with a milk bottle and a promise to his sister, then moves to apologies, a patch of clover and a tight outfit. Later scenes include a taxi, a closing restaurant, a music shop and a visitor at his flat.
Welcome to the official YouTube home of Mr Bean, the legendary comedy icon loved across the globe! Step into a world of hilarious mishaps, quirky problem-solving, and unforgettable moments that have entertained generations.
